units.source_text: 源氏公子作童子装束，娇艳可爱，改装是可惜的。

en.t: Prince Genji looked so charming and lovely in his boy's attire that it seemed a pity to change his dress.

units.source_text: 但到了十二岁上，照例须举行冠礼[\[25\]](#part1330.html#m25)，改作成人装束。

en.t: But when he reached the age of twelve, custom required that he undergo the coming-of-age ceremony, and he was changed into adult attire.

units.source_text: 为了举办这仪式，皇上日夜操心，躬亲指挥。

en.t: To arrange this ceremony, the Emperor worried over it day and night and personally directed the preparations.

units.source_text: 在例行制度之外，又添加种种排场，规模十分盛大。

en.t: Beyond the usual formal requirements, he added all sorts of splendid display, making the scale exceptionally grand.

units.source_text: 当年皇太子的冠礼，在紫宸殿[\[26\]](#part1330.html#m26)举行，非常隆重；

en.t: The Crown Prince's coming-of-age ceremony in those days had been held in the Shishinden Hall and had been extremely solemn and magnificent;

units.source_text: 此次源氏公子的冠礼，务求不亚于那一次。

en.t: for Prince Genji's ceremony this time, every effort was made to ensure that it would be no less splendid than that occasion.

units.source_text: 各处的飨宴，向来由内藏寮及谷仓院[\[27\]](#part1330.html#m27)当作公事办理。

en.t: The banquets in the various places had always been handled as official business by the Bureau of the Palace Storehouses and the Granary Office.

units.source_text: 但皇上深恐他们办得不周到，因此颁布特旨，责令办得尽善尽美。

en.t: But the Emperor was deeply afraid that their arrangements might be inadequate, so he issued a special order requiring everything to be done to perfection.

units.source_text: 在皇上所常居的清凉殿的东厢里，朝东设置皇上的玉座；

en.t: In the eastern wing of the Seiryoden, where the Emperor usually resided, the imperial seat was set facing east;

units.source_text: 玉座前面设置冠者源氏及加冠大臣的座位。

en.t: in front of the throne, seats were arranged for Genji, the young man receiving the cap, and for the minister who would place it on him.
